# signoz_data_retention (Resource)

Manages data retention settings in SigNoz. This is a singleton resource — only one instance should exist per SigNoz deployment. Removing this resource from Terraform only removes it from state; the retention settings persist in SigNoz.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage SigNoz data retention settings.
# This is a singleton resource — only one instance should exist.
resource "signoz_data_retention" "this" {
  metrics_ttl_duration_hrs      = 720 # 30 days
  metrics_move_ttl_duration_hrs = 0   # cold storage disabled
  logs_ttl_duration_hrs         = 360 # 15 days
  logs_move_ttl_duration_hrs    = 0
  traces_ttl_duration_hrs       = 168 # 7 days
  traces_move_ttl_duration_hrs  = 0
}
```

## Import

Import existing data retention settings (any import ID is accepted):

```shell
terraform import signoz_data_retention.this settings
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cold_storage_volume` (String) Cold storage volume applied to every signal with a move TTL set. The server only performs a cold-storage move when a volume is configured; without it move settings are ignored.
- `logs_move_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours before moving logs to cold storage (whole days). 0 means disabled; requires cold_storage_volume.
- `logs_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours to retain logs data (whole days; set via the v2 custom-retention API). Default is 720 (30 days).
- `metrics_move_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours before moving metrics to cold storage. 0 means disabled.
- `metrics_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours to retain metrics data. Default is 720 (30 days).
- `traces_move_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours before moving traces to cold storage. 0 means disabled.
- `traces_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours to retain traces data. Default is 720 (30 days).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic ID for the data retention settings. Always "settings".
